data.question: my boss invited my work gmail but google keeps picking the OTHER one. not getting in

spans.text: This usually happens because your browser is automatically signing you into your primary Google account instead of the specific one your boss invited.
TableCards invitations are tied directly to the email address that received them.
To ensure you sign in with the correct account, try these steps:
**Use an Incognito or Private window:** Copy the invitation link and paste it into an Incognito/Private window.
This prevents your browser from automatically using your other Google sessions and will force you to type in your work Gmail credentials.
**Sign out of all Google accounts:** In your regular browser, sign out of all active Google accounts, then sign back in using only your work email before clicking the invite.
If you still cannot access the workspace after trying an Incognito window, please double-check with your boss to confirm they sent the invite to the exact email address you are trying to use.
